title: Hardware_OSDR_review: metadata audit and 3-D transient CFD of NASA space-biology hardware
description: Code, frozen data snapshot (2026-10-12) of NASA's SPLASH hardware catalogue, OSDR hardware registry, OSDR study metadata and OSDR Environmental Data App cabin telemetry, a hardware crosswalk, a minimum-information checklist for CFD of specimen environments (MI-CFD-HW) with a validated automated scorer, a meta-analysis of hardware metadata sufficiency, literature-curated hardware specifications in which every value carries a verbatim source quotation, OpenFOAM v2606 case generators with verification (heated-cavity benchmark, diffusion, grid convergence), reduced 0 g / 1 g CFD results, orthographic drawings and the LaTeX manuscript sources with PDF/DOCX/HTML builds.
notes: Code: MIT. Data, curated specifications, figures and manuscript: CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA.md). SPLASH data were obtained from NASA's Space Life Sciences Archive of Scientific Hardware (SPLASH).
